semantics: evidence-backed governance control catalog; framework references are descriptive crosswalks, not compliance, certification, or legal conclusions

nist_ai_rmf_1_0.name: NIST AI Risk Management Framework 1.0
nist_ai_rmf_1_0.status_note: Published framework used for this crosswalk; NIST states that a revision is in progress.

iso_iec_42001_2023.name: ISO/IEC 42001:2023
iso_iec_42001_2023.status_note: Theme-level crosswalk only; no clause-level conformity or certification claim.

eu_ai_act_2024_1689.name: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (Artificial Intelligence Act)
eu_ai_act_2024_1689.status_note: Illustrative crosswalk to high-risk-system governance themes only; this repository does not claim that the study is a regulated high-risk AI system or that it satisfies legal obligations.

controls.mechanism: UCI Adult source files are bound to DOI, source URL, and SHA-256 identities before analysis evidence is accepted.
controls.limitations: Content identity and provenance are evidenced; data quality, representativeness, fairness, and legal-basis obligations are not certified by this control.

controls.objective: Preserve acquisition provenance and require preregistration before primary-data retrieval.
controls.mechanism: Acquisition is tied to a verified externally anchored preregistration capsule and source hashes.
controls.limitations: This demonstrates study provenance, not enterprise data-access approval, retention, consent, or privacy governance.

controls.objective: Govern train/test partition specification and usage.
controls.mechanism: The deterministic split procedure, seed range, sizes, experiment usage, and baseline partition-spec identity are independently checked against all committed fits.
controls.limitations: No separately governed validation set or prospectively persisted row-membership digest exists.

controls.objective: Freeze the scientific specification before primary-data access.
controls.mechanism: Configuration, protocol, study design, runtime policy, package lock, project metadata, and scientific source files are cryptographically frozen.
controls.limitations: A scientific design lock is not an enterprise approval workflow or segregation-of-duties control.

controls.objective: Anchor the preregistered scientific identity outside the mutable working tree.
controls.mechanism: The preregistration capsule is tied to immutable GitHub release v0.7.1 and verified before protected execution paths.
controls.limitations: One external hosting platform remains a trust dependency; a second independently controlled anchor is still desirable.

controls.objective: Record and constrain the reference execution environment.
controls.mechanism: Python, package versions, platform details, thread limits, and environment identity are recorded and checked as part of the study evidence.
controls.limitations: Bit-identical continuous-score hashes may remain platform-sensitive across BLAS/hardware boundaries.

controls.mechanism: Each of 636 fits is assigned deterministic identities linking partition, preprocessing, model specification, training specification, execution context, and committed result evidence.
controls.limitations: The repository stores executed-fit evidence, not trained estimator binaries, production aliases, approval states, or deployment endpoints.

controls.objective: Bind result evidence to behavioural and metric signatures.
controls.mechanism: Per-fit metrics, convergence diagnostics, prediction SHA-256, and score SHA-256 signatures are retained and included in lineage/release evidence.
controls.limitations: These are experiment outputs, not production monitoring logs or post-deployment incident records.

controls.objective: Independently reconstruct configured fits before release authorisation.
controls.mechanism: The release gate independently rebuilds every configured fit and checks metrics and behavioural signatures instead of trusting artifact-to-artifact consistency.
controls.limitations: This is scientific release assurance, not an independent conformity assessment, audit opinion, or regulatory certification.

controls.objective: Prevent in-place redefinition of the completed scientific release.
controls.mechanism: CI verifies the protected scientific tree against the externally immutable v0.7.1 preregistration capsule and rejects drift, local lock rewriting, identity-path divergence, and path escapes.
controls.limitations: This repository control does not replace organizational change advisory boards, access controls, or formal approval authorities.

controls.mechanism: Explicit negative capability statements distinguish study governance evidence from production registry, RBAC, privacy-retention, deployment-lineage, validation-registry, and certification claims.
controls.limitations: The crosswalk itself is descriptive and must not be presented as proof of compliance with any framework or law.
